title: Chapter 6 Investigation
content:
Chapter 6 Investigation

On the plain covered with lush grass, a figure swayed, swept forward from time to time, and encountered wild beasts on the way, but was cleverly avoided. Suddenly, the figure stopped, stood on a hillside, fell down, looked down, and his face was full of seriousness.

Ergouzi is a shrewd subordinate of Wang Daniu. Usually, he is very flexible in his mind and is very popular with his boss. Moreover, because he often climbed trees and fished birds, went down rivers to fish, and climbed mountains and ridges when he was a child, he was very familiar with the mountains. He is very good at inquiring about information. Wang Daniu just introduced that after Zhong Yu's order, ten people jumped out from his men, and Ergouzi was one of them.

Ergouzi looked at the place where the smoke was rising below, where more than 20 people were cooking, and looking at their appearance, they were still in the original drilling wood to make fire.

Both hands vigorously rubbed the wood with the palms of their hands. After a long time, a spark appeared, and then they hit the prey, stuck them with wooden sticks, and roasted them on the fire.

Then a group of people gathered next to the bonfire, sang unknown songs together, and danced the primitive dance of the tribe, looking harmonious and happy!

It seems that they are living very comfortably. Damn, I think when I was in the Yellow Turban Army, I was hungry and full, and I didn't know when I would be killed by the officials or starved to death!

These people were able to eat meat and live so comfortably. Thinking about it, they felt hateful. Ergouzi looked on, and his eyes were full of jealous flames.

Ergouzi watched the tribal carnival of the group of savages below, and his heart was full of desire to destroy. He could not wait to go back immediately and report the information here to the lord, and let the lord come to destroy them.

But thinking of his own mission, he still forced the jealousy in his heart to be suppressed. After carefully observing the fighting power of this tribe for a while, he found that it was not very strong. There are only eleven adult men, twelve adult women, and six children, no elderly.

It seems that the old people should be given up by them, just like in our village, those old people who could not take care of their own lives and bring certain benefits to their families during those bad times, in order not to To burden my own family, I would choose to climb the mountain alone and starve to death alone or be eaten by wild animals.

It seems that in this regard, those who are able to be similar to us do not have enough food to feed the old and weak, so they can only give up on them and raise some children to continue the hope of the village.

These thoughts flashed in my heart, but Ergouzi quickly climbed down the hillside, and walked down slowly and very cautiously, so that they could not find out. If they found out that they were vigilant, then they would have sinned greatly .

On the way, I encountered a few beasts and almost found Ergouzi, but Ergouzi avoided them smartly, and ran back to Luoyang without any danger along the way.

After I came back, I found that when I went out just now, three or four of my companions had come back. I couldn't help being a little disappointed. I thought I was the first.

Er Gouzi reported to Wang Daniu what he had detected, and was questioned carefully by Wang Daniu. Almost all Er Gouzi became impatient with Wang Daniu, and finally Wang Daniu gave up.

The collected information was sorted out by Wang Daniu, and he brought Er Gouzi to report to Zhong Yu. On the way to the hall, Ergouzi was reminded several times by Wang Daniu, what etiquette should you pay attention to when you see the lord? What to say and what not to say? Be sure to be respectful and not make the lord angry.

Wang Ergou was named by Wang Daniu Erti, and he felt a little disapproving in his heart, but he still felt the seriousness of his superior, and secretly wrote it down in his heart.

Along the way, I walked through several corridors and came to the hall where official business was being handled. Looking straight ahead, I saw a man with an ordinary face and not very fancy clothes, but sitting there, there was an infinitely majestic man looking at him.

Ergouzi couldn't help but sighed in his heart, put away the little thought in his heart, carefully recalled the details of Wang Daniu's account, performed some etiquette, and solemnly reported his investigation to Zhong Yu.

In the lobby, Zhong Yuzheng sat upright on the office seat. The seat was located in the center of the lobby, upright and supreme. Zhong Yu sat in it, and there was infinite majesty on his body, but at this time he was not in the mood to think about it.

Zhong Yu thought back to the previous report of the four scouts. Among the four tribes, there were two small tribes with more than a dozen people. The adult battle strength was only eight or nine of him. There are more than a dozen people in the tribe of many people, but for themselves, it should be easy to win.

Well, thinking of this, Zhong Yu couldn't help but feel relieved, and when he came back to his senses, Zhong Yu looked at the Ergouzi who was still leaning over and bowed down, and couldn't help but smile with satisfaction.

"Well, you did a good job, go down, go to the warehouse, you have a pound of grain and a tael of meat as a reward for your hard work, go down and work hard in the future, I will not treat you badly!"

Ergouzi heard Zhong Yu's award, and his heart was full of excitement, that was the lord of the highest! To treat me so kindly, is really a kind lord, I must die in the future to repay the kindness of the lord to me today!

And meat, how long have you not eaten meat? Thinking like this in my heart, tears could not help overflowing from my eyes, spinning in my eyes, and my voice choked back.

"I can't repay the kindness of the lord, I can only repay the kindness of the lord with this life in the future!"

Seeing Ergouzi's expression, Zhong Yu's heart was full of complacency. Sure enough, the way of the royal family, the rewards and punishments are clear, can make the subordinates use their lives, but he couldn't help but say:

"You worked hard for me, and of course I can't let you down. Okay, no need, go on, just remember to work hard for me in the future."

Ergouzi calmed down his excitement, tears just held back in his eyes and didn't stay, and then said in a trembling voice, "Yes, this subordinate retire."

Then he hunched over, stepped backward, slowly backed away, and gradually left the hall.

After a while, maybe an hour? Wang Daniu brought a few more people over. Among them, Zhong Yu made another show, and he has been moving the scouts.

Ten scouts, the investigation situation was reported slowly, Zhong Yu's heart slowly emerged the situation around 20 miles, there were eleven tribes, three tribes with less than 20 members, 50 members, and the following tribes. There are four tribes, two tribes with less than 100 members, and two tribes with more than 100 members.

The two largest tribes had about 200 people. The strength is too strong, and it is not something that I can compare with now, but as long as I annex two small tribes a little, then the strength can be greatly increased. When will it be? These two big tribes are not yet to be kneaded by themselves.

Zhong Yu thought so in his heart, but he was thinking about his own attack plan. How could he not be discovered by a larger tribe? There are too many places to think about how to minimize your losses.

Finally, after thinking for a long time, Zhong Yu determined the general plan and waited for the implementation later.

So, now, I want to unify the tribes of 20 and 50 people first? At that time, he should be able to reach more than 100 households, a pavilion-level territory.

Since that's the case, then I'll decide like this. I'll gather troops later, first annex a few tribes with a dozen people, and then the tribes with less than 50 people, and then the lottery can be drawn.

Newbie on the road, ask for support.
